newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares down, seen tracking sideways.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares down, seen tracking sideways.

text.p: Slovenian shares dropped 2.91 percent on Thursday, but traders said there still remained a glimmer of hope in the market.
"I think recent falls are a technical reaction to the wave of enthusiasm initiated by foreigners entering the market. Shares will oscillate in the next two weeks," one broker said.
* The SBI index shed 34.06 points to 1,136.9.
* Turnover fell to 382.3 million tolars from 576.1 million.
* Bank SKB was most actively traded and the leading decliner, tumbling 6.26 percent to 36,070 tolars.
